summary: requireUser 401s if Clerk webhook hasn't landed — add lazy upsert

resolution.test_function: lazy upsert when DB row is missing (todo:a7ffea2b)
resolution.note: On a missing users row for a signed-in Clerk user, requireUser() now fetches currentUser() and INSERT ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING with primary email, then re-SELECTs. Soft-deleted accounts still 401 (ON CONFLICT no-op). Six new test cases covering each branch.
